__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus datasource with monerod metrics from node_exporter textfile collector

description: Comprehensive Monero node monitoring dashboard for PiNodeXMR devices. Tracks blockchain sync, network connections, mempool, mining difficulty, disk usage, and device health via Prometheus textfile collector.

links.title: GitHub Repository
links.tooltip: PiNodeXMR Grafana Dashboard source code and documentation

panels.title: Node Up
panels.description: Whether the monerod daemon is running and reachable

panels.title: Sync Status
panels.description: Whether the node is fully synchronized with the Monero network

panels.title: Blockchain Height
panels.description: Current blockchain height of the local node

panels.title: Network Difficulty
panels.description: Current Monero network mining difficulty

panels.title: Monero Version
panels.description: Running monerod version reported by the daemon

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the monerod daemon was started

panels.title: Total Transactions
panels.description: Total number of transactions in the Monero blockchain

panels.title: Hard Fork Version
panels.description: Current Monero hard fork (consensus) version

panels.title: P2P Connections
panels.description: Incoming and outgoing peer-to-peer connections to the Monero network

panels.title: Peerlist Size
panels.description: White (known good) and grey (untested) peers in the local peerlist

panels.title: RPC Connections
panels.description: Active RPC connections to the monerod JSON-RPC interface

panels.title: Mempool Transactions
panels.description: Number of unconfirmed transactions waiting in the mempool (TX pool)

panels.title: Mempool Size (Bytes)
panels.description: Total size of all transactions in the mempool

panels.title: Mempool Fees (XMR)
panels.description: Total fees of all transactions currently in the mempool, converted to XMR

panels.title: Fee Per Byte (atomic)
panels.description: Estimated fee per byte in atomic units (piconero)

panels.title: Block Reward (XMR)
panels.description: Reward for the most recently mined block, converted from atomic units to XMR

panels.title: Block Size
panels.description: Size of the most recently mined block in bytes

panels.title: Transactions per Block
panels.description: Number of transactions in the most recently mined block

panels.title: Network Difficulty
panels.description: Monero network mining difficulty over time — higher values indicate more hash power securing the network

panels.title: Blockchain DB Size
panels.description: Size of the Monero LMDB blockchain database on disk

panels.title: Free Disk Space (Blockchain)
panels.description: Free space remaining on the blockchain storage volume as reported by monerod

panels.title: Disk Usage — /mnt/xmrblockchain
panels.description: Percentage of disk space used on the blockchain mount point (/mnt/xmrblockchain)

panels.title: CPU Temperature
panels.description: SoC / CPU temperature of the PiNodeXMR device

panels.title: CPU Usage %
panels.description: Overall CPU utilisation across all cores

panels.title: Memory Usage
panels.description: RAM utilisation — used vs. available memory

panels.title: System Load
panels.description: System load averages (1m, 5m, 15m) — compare against 4 CPU cores

panels.title: Network Traffic (eth0)
panels.description: Ethernet receive and transmit throughput

panels.title: Disk I/O (Blockchain SSD)
panels.description: Read and write throughput on the blockchain storage device (sda)

title: PiNodeXMR - Monero Node Monitor
